steps.note: S1.3.1a states that rows 0 and 1 subtract Ja+Rc, the target gains (JV+RG)x whatever a and c are, and a and c are restored, matching the paper.

S1.3.1b gives the central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, says the side injection cancels the intersection-one cases, and gives the net map y<-y+x; the self coefficient one is implied by that net map rather than stated separately.
S1.3.1b's parenthetical gives the complex central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2, cancelled for intersections zero and two.
S1.3.1c gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with the inverse schedule in the middle, and S1.3.1 and S1.3.1a say each invocation restores its scratch wires.
The plan says every edge joins nested labels (S1.3.4a1) and names the center 3->4 residual P⊗F, but it never gives the table of per-edge orthogonal residuals and their dimensions.
S1.3.3c gives P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^⊥ from t_X⊥t_Y (the paper's line 953), but it omits the edge 2->5 residual <t_X,t_Y>^⊥ and its dimension h-2.
The plan states the only decreasing edge is center 3->4 with loss h, telescoping at gates, sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N, and absolute Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich.
S2.1 mentions an orthonormal basis of each residual, but the plan never argues that nonzero residuals over F2 are nondegenerate and nonalternating, nor that alternating planes are absorbed.
The plan defines the phase frames C_U (S2.1) but never states that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors or the formula q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v·x].
S2.1 asserts that edge changes are products of kernels aI+bX_v but omits the derivation that wt(v) is odd, the phase is i^{ε[v·x]}, and H diag(1,-1) H = X.
The plan states one kernel per residual basis vector (S2.1), applied as one tensor-power factor (C^{ε_h})^{⊗f} across the f columns per residual direction (S2.2), with s_c such calls in all (S2.3).

The plan asserts the endpoint operator C^{⊗m} on every role and that endpoint corrections add no calls, but it omits the zero/full label frames I and C^{⊗m}, the C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates of X_a->Y_a, the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair, and the negation of the X outputs.
The plan states L/N<1/2, so the deficit N-2L>0 and the rank sum s<Wm.
The plan does not give η_b=339/22587335000000.
The plan does not give η_c=73/19906842167500.

S1.3.6 states that the relative deficit exceeds 20·2^-50 and that m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20·2^-50), giving s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^-50; it does not state the log m<20 justification or the complex case explicitly.
S1.3.7 states the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 with exactly a ones but not the elimination proof (topmost-row rightmost pivot, lower-triangular clearing, repetition on the active indices).
The plan works over Z/q^b but never says that a fixed odd prime is chosen to avoid every denominator in a finite table so that the identities specialize with invertible triangular factors.
S1.3.8a states that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V), updating coordinates in descending order, each as a unit times itself plus earlier coordinates.
S1.3.8b gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j: one interchange per one of Π, a in all.

The plan gives B=s+E, Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ and C_1=20 (S2.8, S2.8b, S2.8c) but never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, ν, or C_0=128mB^2 (the latter only appears inside the S2.8c quote of line 2557), so the constants' defining content is incomplete.
S2.8a states A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E at an internal node (branching s, not s/W) and A(e)≤8e at a leaf; it does not separately state that the per-invocation count is below E.
S2.8b gives A(e)≤8dB^{k+1}≤8B^2 d^{ν+1}, and S2.8c bounds the total with the piece count, phases and shift by C_0 d^{C_1}.
S2.8d states that values at depth ℓ lie in 2^{-(p+ℓ)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^ℓ, that p+Δ fractional and Δ+3 integer bits suffice, and that εC_1<1 keeps the width O(p) (with S2.8 giving Δ=o(p)).
S2.9 states absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the single truncation errs by less than √2·2^{-p}.

summary: P02 covers the bank-exchange network (4/4), the telescoping count and loss ratios of the label budget (2/5), the per-column tensoring of the phase interface (1/4), the deficit and exponent comparison of the rank saving (2/4), the triangular cost and the one-interchange trick of the matrix shear (2/4), and most of the simultaneous-layer depth argument (4/5). It omits the residual table, the h-2 side residual, the F2 orthonormal-basis argument, the weight-additivity and kernel derivation, the endpoint repairs, the exact η values, the elimination proof, the choice of prime, and the definitions of E, ν and C_0. 15 of 26 present, none wrong.
